issue_context.title: goroutine leaks in TestConfigurationChannels
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

Two goroutines are leaked in [TestConfigurationChannels](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/util/config/config_test.go#L24-L34). 

The two goroutines are created inside function mux.Channel() ([line 77](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/util/config/config.go#L77)). They block at the range statement ([line 82](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/util/config/config.go#L82)) since the channel listenChannel is not closed in the unit test. 

However, wait.Until() is called with wait.NeverStop at line 77. Even though we close the channels returned by mux.Channel(), we still not resolve the leaked goroutines. 

### What did you expect to happen?

No goroutines are blocked when the test finishes. 

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

The bug can be easily reproduced by executing the unit test. 

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_

### Kubernetes version

All recent versions (e.g., 00bbea47e85befa8bf90ac3e88e7bfa4f3886f88) have this problem.

None

review_comments: Rather than doing this for backwards compatibility, I wonder if it'd be cleaner to add a new method to the type. E.g. `ChannelWithContext(ctx context.Context, source string) chan interface{}`.
Actually, this is not in library code (not in `staging`) so might just break the signature and update the callers.

hi @ash2k,  if we add a new method there, do we need to look at all callers?  If so, I would like the PR to add the new method and update `TestConfigurationChannels `. Then create a new PR to update all the callers. and decide whether they should call the new method or the old.

I think we don't need yet another method, we can just change this one. The caller should always be responsible for stopping the goroutines they start, so a method without a way to stop them is a bad API. Hence, in my opinion, we should change this one rather just than adding a new one (change bad API to good API).

I found a lot of code in the kubelet that uses wait.NeverStop, which doesn't seem to care about stopping the goroutine. If we change this method to `ChannelWithContext(ctx context.Context, source string) chan interface`, we need to cancel this ctx somewhere uniformly, but I can't find the right place
It's fine, we don't need to fix the world in this PR :)
